messages:
Sam Evans: Dropping the pen-test + vuln-scan evidence for the Acme POC here. Need customer review and sign-off on remediation timeline by EOD Friday so we can finalize pricing/commit. S3 path: s3://redwood-evidence/acme/2033456789/

Sam Evans: Checksums attached for quick verification:
```
$ sha256sum acme-pt-report.pdf
3b7e9f2a1c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0  acme-pt-report.pdf
$ sha256sum vuln-scan.json
9f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e1f0  vuln-scan.json
```

Jenny Lee: Quick Q — this includes external blackbox + authenticated app scan + host-level checks for the bastion, correct? Do we have a scope doc we can hand the customer?

Sam Evans: Correct — external + authenticated web app + selected host checks. Scope doc: s3://redwood-evidence/acme/2033456789/scope.yaml
Remediation mapping: remediation.csv in the same folder.

Priya Singh (Security): High-level review: 
- Critical: RCE in upload handler (ticket RW-4532) — reproducible in staging.
- High: Outdated OpenSSL on bastion (CVE mapping included).
- Medium: Info leakage via verbose headers.
Action items (short):
- RW-4532 (eng-runtime) — owner: @Mike Huang — ETA: 48–72h from now
- OpenSSL upgrade (eng-infra) — owner: @Anna Kim — ETA: 5 days; temporary WAF rule applied
- Header cleanup (product) — owner: @Jessica Park — ETA: 3 days
Please include CVE refs in the bundle and link PRs when available.

QA Team: Flagged 3 false positives from the container scanner (cookie secure/httponly) — staging uses non-prod flags. Example snippet:
```
"vuln-scan.json": {
  "path": "/api/session",
  "issue": "Cookie flag missing",
  "notes": "staging-only config, not present in prod"
}
```

Sales Ops: Customer legal asked for an exec summary + checklist for their vendor review. Can we produce a 1-page risk summary + remediation ETA table by tomorrow?

Sam Evans: Pasting an exec summary below and also put at s3://redwood-evidence/acme/2033456789/exec-summary.txt:
- Status: Evidence bundle uploaded, no active exploitation observed in our logs.
- Highest risk: RCE in upload handler (fix in progress).
- Mitigations: WAF rule in place for exploit patterns; patch PR incoming.
- Deliverables: signed evidence bundle, PR links, CVE map, and timeframe for patch verification.
Expected deliverable date to customer: next Wednesday (firm date in calendar invite).

sre-bot: Evidence upload complete to gs://redwood-evidence-acme/2033456789/ (42MB). MD5: d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e

Jenny Lee: I'll set up a 30m review with Acme SecOps — Tue 10:00am PT. @Priya will you join? @Mike Huang can you join to walk through the repro?

Priya Singh (Security): Yes, will join. Also request remediation PR links and CVE references included in pre-read.

Mike Huang: I'll attach the RW-4532 PR and test plan before EOD Mon. Repro steps and PoC are in the ticket.

Anna Kim: OpenSSL upgrade scheduled on the bastion fleet; will roll patch in canary tomorrow and then full rollout in 5 days.

Jessica Park: Will do header cleanup PR and small config change to remove server tokens — targeting EOD Tue.

Sam Evans: Thanks — I'll collate PR links, CVE mapping, and an SLA-style remediation timeline and drop into the S3 folder. Also will prepare the 1-page summary for legal. :thumbsup:

Sales Ops: Customer asked for an archive of raw scan artifacts (zipped) + checksums and a signed attestation. Who can sign? Legal wants a named engineer + security approver.

Sam Evans: I'll coordinate signatures from Security (Priya) and Eng (Mike). Plan to upload signed bundle by Tue COB after the Acme review call.

Jenny Lee: Noted. Closing the loop: call scheduled, artifacts in S3, PRs/ETAs as above. We'll send the follow-up email to Acme after the call with the bundle link.

Sam Evans: For the record — timeline we communicated to the customer in the call invite:
- Initial mitigation (WAF rules): within 24h (completed)
- Patch PR open: within 48–72h
- Patch rollout & verification: within 5 business days
- Signed evidence + attestation: within 7 calendar days

Sam Evans: Any blockers from Legal or Compliance?

Sales Ops: Legal requested a copy of our SOC2 AICPA control mappings for their vendor form. I'll request the SOC2 mapping doc and add to the bundle.

Sam Evans: Perfect. If no other blockers, I'll mark this thread as owner for evidence handoff and remediation cadence. Thanks everyone! :white_check_mark:
